features.name: Repository discovery
features.description: Discovers newly created repositories from GH Archive, GitHub Search, and trending search passes.
known_limitations: GitHub Search coverage depends on rate limits and query windows.
follow_up_work: Expose source mix and data completeness in public discovery views.

features.name: Repository enrichment
features.description: Refreshes GitHub metadata, metrics, topics, releases, and deletion/archive status for discovered repositories.
known_limitations: Live refresh depends on GitHub API availability and token budget.
follow_up_work: Keep production p95 refresh timing visible in admin telemetry.

features.name: Repository classification
features.description: Classifies enriched repositories into durable categories and computes Interesting Score signals.
known_limitations: Some category signals are heuristic and should be presented as derived intelligence.
follow_up_work: Version classification outputs as first-class intelligence artifacts.

features.name: Repository clustering
features.description: Groups repositories into ecosystem and intent clusters using deterministic cluster definitions.
known_limitations: Cluster definitions are curated and require version bumps when rules change.
follow_up_work: Expose cluster provenance through the future Evidence Graph.

features.name: Emerging Topics
features.description: Detects emerging topics from comparable discovery windows and explains score components.
known_limitations: Production may contain older v1 rows until the detector reruns.
follow_up_work: Persist duplicate family records if repeated runs show unstable grouping.

features.name: Emerging topic evidence deduplication
features.description: Copied, forked, templated, and near-identical repositories are grouped into independent evidence families before scoring emerging topics.
known_limitations: Duplicate families are recomputed into evidence_json, not persisted as manual-reviewable rows.
follow_up_work: Add persistent family IDs plus manual merge/split overrides.

features.name: Stale detection-version filtering
features.description: Emerging topic detail pages and materialized homepage payloads ignore rows produced by older detection versions.
known_limitations: Stale records remain in the database for audit/history until recomputed.
follow_up_work: Expose stale/current detection mismatch in admin diagnostics.

features.name: Stale topic recomputation page
features.description: Direct URLs for old-version-only emerging topics show an awaiting-recomputation state instead of a generic 404.
known_limitations: The message does not trigger recomputation by itself.
follow_up_work: Add an admin-only action to queue a current-version recomputation.

features.name: Birth Feed
features.description: Shows newly discovered repository births with filtering, pagination, and archive/intelligence badges.
known_limitations: Feed quality depends on discovery/enrichment freshness.
follow_up_work: Add route-level smoke coverage.

features.name: Website discovery
features.description: Detects repositories that expose public websites and tracks verification state.
known_limitations: External website checks are inherently network-sensitive.
follow_up_work: Expose website verification failures in data-quality reports.

features.name: Dedicated search
features.description: Provides a separate repository search surface with configurable page sizes and export affordances.
known_limitations: Search quality depends on FTS freshness and enriched metadata.
follow_up_work: Add usage telemetry for result-size performance.

features.name: TSV search export
features.description: Exports bounded repository lists as spreadsheet-safe TSV with repository names and GitHub links.
known_limitations: Exports are bounded to the requested result window.
follow_up_work: Expose export error telemetry.

features.name: Immediate repository navigation
features.description: Repository pages render stored intelligence immediately before stale metadata refresh is queued.
known_limitations: Freshness still depends on the async refresh queue succeeding.
follow_up_work: Measure fresh-vs-stale p50/p95 after deployment.

features.name: Bounded stale metadata refresh
features.description: Deduplicates and bounds background refreshes triggered by repository page views.
known_limitations: Queue state is in-process and should be watched after restarts.
follow_up_work: Surface refresh dedupe hit rate in operations telemetry.

features.name: Navigation progress indicator
features.description: Shows progress feedback for slower navigations without delaying fast page transitions.
known_limitations: Visual behavior is not covered by automated browser tests.
follow_up_work: Add lightweight Playwright smoke coverage if browser testing is introduced.

features.name: Server timing
features.description: Separates server timing values such as database, refresh queue, and total response time for production measurement.
known_limitations: Historical performance aggregation is not yet persisted.
follow_up_work: Store sampled route timings for p50/p95 reports.

features.name: Homepage discovery signals
features.description: Homepage emphasizes Archive Pulse, discovery sections, and repository intelligence before raw tables. Discovery sections are served from durable materialized payloads with live-query fallback when materialization is missing or stale.
known_limitations: Materialized discovery payloads can lag behind source/detection code within the explicit freshness window.
Archive Pulse remains a separate in-process cache (not part of readiness materialization).
follow_up_work: Expose materialization age and stale payload warnings in the homepage UI.

features.name: Homepage readiness and high-signal materialization
features.description: Independently materializes homepage readiness aggregates and high-signal repository cards into a durable snapshot with live fallback, explicit staleness, source watermarks, and failure isolation from discovery materialization.
known_limitations: Snapshot invalidates on age or corpus watermarks (enriched/classified/repo count); rapid enrich bursts force live fallback until the next cadence.
Archive Pulse is not included in this snapshot.
follow_up_work: Expose readiness snapshot age and watermark mismatch in the homepage UI.
Optionally surface homepage_readiness in admin status panels.

features.name: System-health display
features.description: Admin pages show daemon, job, archive, enrichment, and discovery health for operations.
known_limitations: Admin telemetry is not yet exposed through a stable external API.
follow_up_work: Prefer githubarchive-mcp operational tools as the stable read-only API for agent workflows.

features.name: GithubArchive+ MCP intelligence server
features.description: Read-only MCP server that exposes project state, feature registry, decisions, archive data, workspace review, and change-validation tools for AI coding agents.
known_limitations: Stdio transport requires a stderr-clean launcher; npm lifecycle banners break JSON-RPC.
MCP Apps UI is out of scope.
Homepage materialization tools depend on discovery_system_status presence.
follow_up_work: Keep Feature Registry and Decision Journal synchronized when MCP-facing behavior changes.
Add smoke coverage for untested public routes surfaced by review_workspace.
